text_block_list.text:
I found myself shouting at the top of my 
lungs. The race to determine the strongest 
of the generation, the "Japanese Derby"— 
and the winner was Cheval Grand—!
(WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Well done, Cheval Grand!! Awesome! I 
can't believe it!!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
...Are these... cheers...? The ground is 
shaking—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(How did it... turn out...? Everything was 
just... such a blur...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
...I was on guard. And yet, even more so 
than when we trained together... she's—
—Cheval.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Congratulations, you were amazing, Cheval.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
To be honest, losing is frustrating, 
but... it was such a thrilling race!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Just you prepare yourself, though. I'll 
observe, formulate a countermeasure, and 
next time— I'll completely figure you out!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Uh... Um, ...huh?
Cheval Grand—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Whoa... Y-Y-Yes, ma'am.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: N-N-Now it's Duramente-san...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: U-Um... d-d-did I do something...?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I will challenge you as well...

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: I will run... in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
In the final race of the Classic Triple 
Crown, I will seize the title of the 
"strongest" without fail. That is why—

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...You come too. At the Kikuka Sho, once 
more with me—"
(Murmur... murmur...)

text_block_list.name: Duramente's Fan
text_block_list.text:
H-Hey, did you hear that? She just said 
the Kikuka Sho... Does that mean she gave 
up on the Prix de l'Arc de Triomphe...?

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text: ...... Allow me to declare it once more.

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"To prove my bloodline, I will demonstrate 
what it means to be the 'strongest'――"

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
First, the domestic scene. In the upcoming 
Kikuka Sho, I will definitely seize 
victory!

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
And after that, the world. That is where—I 
will fulfill my long-cherished 
ambition...!
(WOOOOOOOOOOAAAHHH!!!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Wow! Duramente's surprisingly flashy with 
what she does, isn't she?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Though what I want to say might be the 
same— Cheval, don't forget my declaration 
of war too, okay?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Next time, I will beat you. On the 
prestige of the Satono family, and on my 
pride—!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh... Ah...—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(What is... this...? I can't even process 
my feelings yet...)

text_block_list.name: Race Participant Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... *sniff*. It's... over, the Derby... 
I promised I'd win... no matter what... 
*sob*...

text_block_list.name: Race Participant Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
"I worked so hard for today... all this 
time...! Damn it, damn it, damn it! I 
could have done so much better!!"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: (Why do I feel so left behind...?!)

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
(Even though I won... I was supposed to 
have won...)

When I went to greet Cheval Grand after 
her race, for some reason, she wore a 
dazed expression.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I-I feel... strange...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm supposed to have won... an amazing 
race... Yet feelings like "I did it..." or 
"I'm amazing"... Nothing like that comes 
to mind at all...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I... couldn't answer properly...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
They challenged me, saying they'd win next 
time... Two runners that strong... to 
someone like me...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I-I know...! Just thinking of myself as 
'unworthy' is... rude in itself.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: But... compared to their resolve, I'm...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"I wasn't enough... If I had made my own 
choice, staked everything on it, and given 
it my all, things surely would've been 
different..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Even though the two of them acknowledged 
me... I... I couldn't accept myself...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm so pathetic... Leaving things 
half-done like this... I—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
The truth is... maybe I didn't have the 
right to run today in the first place...!

Watching Cheval Grand blame herself, I 
didn't know what words to say.

Her body had grown much faster and bigger 
than expected. Yet in her heart, she 
remained cowering, still unable to find 
confidence.

And so, leaving major challenges 
unresolved, Cheval Grand's Japanese Derby 
came to an end.

Unlike the body, changes of the heart take 
a long time. Walking that journey together 
with her— I reflected that this was all I 
could do.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ……*sob*…… *sniff*. Ugh…… aah……!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: It's... over... The Derby... my...—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: ......Teio-san...
